title: Trim the start or end of a Clipchamp clip
note: In Clipchamp, select the timeline clip and drag its left or right edge inward to shorten the visible section. Drag outward to restore available source footage. For many assets, select multiple clips and trim together; use gap removal afterward if spacing is unintended.

title: Split a timeline video or audio clip in Clipchamp
note: To split in Clipchamp, highlight the timeline asset and place the seeker at the desired cut point. Click the scissors Split control or press S, creating two pieces that can be moved or deleted separately. When relevant, select both audio and video before splitting.

title: Insert and adjust Clipchamp video transitions
note: Place two adjacent assets in the Clipchamp timeline without a gap, then drag a transition from the Transitions toolbar between them. Select the transition and adjust its type or duration in the property panel. A fade control on an asset handles fade-in/out separately.

title: Fade video or audio in Clipchamp
note: For a fade on a clip or soundtrack in Clipchamp, select the timeline item and open the Fade tab in its property panel. Adjust fade-in and fade-out lengths with the provided sliders or duration fields, then preview the overlap with neighboring clips.
